text:
michael: Heads-up: observability shows a post-deploy p95 drift on /v1/chat for canary. deploybot is recommending autorevert. thoughts?
deploybot: AUTOREVERT_TRIGGER: route=/v1/chat, p95>420ms over 6m, error_rate>2.5% -> recommended action: autorevert to redwood-chat-2.9.1
sara: I see traces pointing to a new attention kernel path on T4s. Not a complete outage but customer-facing latency increase.
jon: change window still open for 25m. prefer controlled manual rollback to coordinate release notes and Dedicated notices.
ops_lead: agree with manual. give 10m triage then roll. prepare rollback checklist and cust messaging.
release_manager: I'll draft the rollback blurb and queue a short note to #customer-facing + support. Need ETA and scope from whoever executes.
sara: quick repro in staging. will start a controlled rollback canary first if we proceed.
jon: can we regionally split traffic as a short mitigation? pin EU to previous model while we run canary in US.
deploybot: PIN_CREATED: route=eu-chat -> model=redwood-chat-2.9.1 at 5112233460 by jon (log)
michael: good. set decision at T+8m. if metrics don't improve, manual global rollback. who executes?
sara: sara will run rollback commands, jon handles pins and traffic split. eng_oncall will watch alerts.
eng_oncall: I'll mute non-critical alerts and keep p95/error dashboards in the loop.
sara: executing manual rollback canary now:```bash
deployctl rollback --route canary --to-model redwood-chat-2.9.1
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/chat-runtime --image=chat-runtime:v2.9.1
```
ops_lead: remember to block auto-promote in deploybot during the operation.
jon: blocking auto-promote. also prepped PR to add a suppress window for deploybot triggers during noisy metric windows.
deploybot: MANUAL_ROLLBACK_STARTED by sara at 5112233465 -> state=started
eng_oncall: canary metrics: p95 down ~45% in the canary slice, errors stable. rolling to global in 2m if stable.
deploybot: MANUAL_ROLLBACK_COMPLETED by sara at 5112233469 -> status=success
release_manager: rollback note posted. sent short Dedicated customer note draft to sales for approval.
michael: follow-ups: (1) add regression test for attention kernel on T4s (2) add an autorevert suppression rule when change window is live (3) postmortem ticket RM-4021 assigned to sara+jon.
ops_lead: filed the ticket and tagged oncall and eng-ml. good run. :thumbsup:
jon: opening hotfix branch for kernel guard. sara, can you run a targeted canary after CI passes?
sara: yes, will coordinate a canary next morning. closing thread.
